ctx: 영화 「The Pickup」(2025, Amazon MGM action comedy, directed by Tim Story). Eddie Murphy as Russell Pierce, a veteran armored-truck guard of the company Guardian six months from retirement, married 25 years to Natalie (Eva Longoria); Pete Davidson as Travis Stolly, his reckless young new partner who wants to be a cop; Keke Palmer as Zoe, a criminal mastermind (her father died locked in a vault in a casino fire) with her crew Banner and Miguel. Story: Travis, a bank guard, once pulled a gun on Zoe who handed him a note, then they dated; boss Clark assigns Russell and Travis a remote route; Zoe's crew ambushes the truck in a dead zone (tear gas, spike strip, dye pack); Zoe takes them hostage — she wants the truck itself to rob the Sorrento casino's weekend take of 60 million dollars; Travis turns out to have been her informant; Natalie joins; they infiltrate the casino (boxing champion distraction); Banner and Miguel betray Zoe, Russell is shot; highway chase, Natalie takes down Banner; truck explosion; Russell gives Natalie a ring and retires. Epilogue six months later: Travis is a police officer, Zoe in Bali, the couple opens a bed and breakfast. Opening credits text appears over the first scenes (0:45~2:40); end credits from 1:29:50 (5390s).
